Sprite maps Sprite2D onto Entity and now inherits through CanvasItem and Node under ADR 0008. SpriteTests and SpriteRenderingTests verify defaults, local geometry, sheet indexing, regions/flips, retained redraw, resource ownership and notifications, owner-thread guards, callback failures and PackedScene reconstruction. Positive grids must fit Int32.MaxValue; invalid arguments throw before mutation. Grid resizing preserves valid coordinates or silently resets Frame; only explicit Frame/FrameCoords changes emit FrameChanged. Texture reference changes emit TextureChanged; resource content changes only request redraw. Typed events/properties follow ADRs 0004/0005; the accepted inheritance is checked by SceneHierarchyTests under ADR 0008. Native pixel verification covers Wayland GPU/compatibility; wider inherited canvas policies are recorded separately. ItemRectChanged now follows texture_changed and precedes frame_changed/property_list_changed, and covers centering, offset and enabled region changes. No event for transforms, RegionEnabled, flipping, clipping or texture contents; synchronous exception/disposal stages follow typed C# event lifetime rules. SpriteTests verifies these paths against pinned sprite_2d.cpp.

GetRect verifies signed dimensions, two-stage integer truncation, centering/offset and the empty one-by-one fallback in SpriteTests. Finite derived geometry is enforced. Trigger: the first viewport pixel-snapping policy slice must apply its offset adjustment here; this inherited behavior is not available yet (ADR 0028).

IsPixelOpaque verifies fractional half-open bounds, source alpha, sheet/region selection, custom Texture dispatch and clamp sampling. Finite input and live nonnegative texture dimensions are required. Signed regions deliberately follow the existing source/destination flip combination in Texture drawing rather than the reference opacity discrepancy. Trigger: the first shared canvas repeat/mirrored-repeat policy slice must apply wrapping here alongside rendering (ADR 0028).

Protected implementation of owner-thread/lifetime validation for the Engine.Run-owned rendering service. Public disposal cannot interrupt an active host or render frame.

Default construction of the existing image-drawing scene-node concept with a borrowed optional Texture; the Sprite name follows the strict 2D naming rule, while its spatial Entity base inherits CanvasItem and Node according to ADR 0008.
Protected implementation of the inherited canvas drawing callback; records the selected frame through the Texture virtual draw hook.
Protected implementation of typed property metadata/storage for the existing sprite properties. Frame grid dimensions restore before Frame; FrameCoords remains a nonstored alias.
Protected implementation of existing PackedScene construction. A static exact-type factory creates detached Sprite instances without retaining the packed source.
Protected managed lifetime hook disconnects the borrowed texture and clears typed events before inherited Entity cleanup; ordinary borrowed resources are not disposed.
